description: This file declares the interface ChargeReadPlatformService, which provides various method signatures for retrieving charge-related data within the Fineract platform. It includes methods to get charges, penalties, fees, and applicable charges for loans, savings, and shares, with filtering options. The interface serves as a contract for implementing classes that perform data retrieval operations related to charges in the financial application.

classes.name: ChargeReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for retrieving various charge data such as loans, savings, penalties, and share charges, in different contexts and based on different parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllCharges
methods.description: Retrieves all charges available in the system.

methods.name: retrieveAllChargesForCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves all charges applicable for a specific currency identified by currency code.

methods.name: retrieveCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific charge by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveNewChargeDetails
methods.description: Provides details necessary for creating a new charge.

methods.name: retrieveAllChargesApplicableToClients
methods.description: Retrieves all charges that can be applied to clients.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicableFees
methods.description: Retrieves all fee charges applicable for loans, excluding penalties.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAccountApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable to a specific loan account, excluding specified charge times.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable for a specific loan product, filtering by charge times.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicablePenalties
methods.description: Retrieves all penalties applicable for loans.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves all charges associated with a specific loan product; overloaded for different filtering options.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsProductApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable for savings products, with an option to filter fee charges only.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsApplicablePenalties
methods.description: Retrieves penalties applicable for savings products.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable for a specific savings product.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable to a specific savings account.

methods.name: retrieveSharesApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charge definitions applicable for shares.

methods.name: retrieveShareProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable for a specific share product.
